# `get_view_plan_stack_result`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Read the saved stack output (filename, image id, stacked seconds, error code) of the last view-plan target.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER / established (64-bit build only; absent from the 32-bit build) |
| Side-effect tier | A |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xbe150, GetViewPlanStackResult @0x193940 (64-bit build only) |

No request parameters are read. Only on device process type 2. A device with no saved output still replies with code 0, has_output false and an error_code in the result. Observer tier A: only caller-owned outputs are written.

Side effects: None beyond request-local data; reads global output variables and copies them out. No timeout.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_view_plan_stack_result"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Not read. Omission, null, object, scalar and array all take the same path. Clients SHOULD omit it. [READ] |

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jsonrpc` | string | no | - | (both) Added by the socket layer (reply object constructor), not the handler fragment. Normally present; absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply. Receivers MUST NOT require it. Fixed value `"2.0"`. [READ; also OBSERVED on the wire (2026-10-12)] |
| `Timestamp` | string | no | - | (both) Decimal string `<seconds>.<nanoseconds>` with exactly nine fractional digits, formatted with `%ld.%09ld` from clock_gettime clock id 1. Linux clock id 1 is CLOCK_MONOTONIC, so the value is monotonic time, not wall-clock or Unix time (INFERRED from the clock id). On replies it is added by the socket layer and is normally present; receivers MUST NOT require it on replies (absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply). On events it is always written by the event constructor. [READ; wire shape also OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |

| `result` | object | yes | - | (get_view_plan_stack_result reply (success)) Saved stack output of the last view-plan target, not the whole queue and not the current frame counter. Always carries the four members; saved_fullname appears only when has_output is true. [READ] |
| `result.has_output` | boolean | yes | - | (get_view_plan_stack_result reply (success)) True when a non-empty saved filename exists. [READ] |
| `result.saved_fullname` | string | if has_output is true | - | (get_view_plan_stack_result reply (success)) Saved output filename. Present only when has_output is true; then error_code is 0. [READ] |
| `result.image_id` | integer | yes | - | (get_view_plan_stack_result reply (success)) Image id, from an unsigned 16-bit value. The value 65535 is the reset value set by set_view_plan_wide_setting (INFERRED role as a no-image marker). Range: >= 0, <= 65535. [READ] |
| `result.stack_total_sec` | number | yes | - | (get_view_plan_stack_result reply (success)) Total stacked time, seconds. [READ] |
| `result.error_code` | integer | yes | - | (get_view_plan_stack_result reply (success)) Result data, not the envelope code. 0 when an output exists; otherwise chosen from the stack or frame failure state, with 267 (no image) for no meaningful output and benign abort paths. [READ] |

Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 210 | Device process type is not 2. A reply with this code was also seen on a device while a stored plan appeared to be imaging, so other triggers are unresolved | `not supported` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

No other handler error exists; empty output is a success with error_code data.

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":80,"method":"get_view_plan_stack_result"}
```

Reply, with-output:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_view_plan_stack_result","result":{"has_output":true,"saved_fullname":"Example_stack.fit","image_id":3,"stack_total_sec":180.0,"error_code":0},"code":0,"id":80}
```

Reply, no-output:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_view_plan_stack_result","result":{"has_output":false,"image_id":65535,"stack_total_sec":0,"error_code":267},"code":0,"id":81}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_view_plan_stack_result","error":"not supported","code":210,"id":82}
```
